Technical Details: An end-to-end AI-powered pipeline that takes a natural-language prompt from a user, classifies the intent, extracts structured agent specifications, generates complete Python agent code, verifies it, and produces documentation — all orchestrated automatically.
Backend pipeline of 5 specialized AI agents orchestrated sequentially, with a Flask web server and a modern dark-themed frontend UI for interactive use.

Description: Automate AI agent code generation from natural language
Technical Details: Users describe an agent in plain English; the system produces a complete, runnable Python project (agent.py, main.py, requirements.txt, README.md) with AI-based verification and documentation.

Description: Developers; AI enthusiasts; non-technical users wanting custom agents
Technical Details: Anyone who wants to quickly prototype or generate an AI agent without writing code manually.
Uses Groq's hosted LLM inference with model 'llama-3.3-70b-versatile' for all AI operations: classification, extraction, code generation, verification, and documentation.
Five specialized agents run in order, each producing an artifact consumed by the next. Pipeline supports skip-on-failure and start-from-step options.

Description: System must classify user input as 'agent_building' or 'conversational'
Technical Details: Uses Groq LLM with a structured classification prompt. Returns JSON with classification, user_text, confidence (high/medium/low), and reason.

Description: For non-building queries, system must provide knowledgeable answers with agent suggestions
Technical Details: When classified as 'conversational', a second LLM call generates an informative answer plus an 'Agent Opportunity' suggestion to nudge users toward building.

Description: Extract structured agent specifications from natural language
Technical Details: Extracts 4 categories via parallel LLM calls: core_specifications, technical_requirements, behavioral_traits, integration_needs. Applies intelligent defaults for missing values.
Output: Structured JSON with 20+ agent specification fields

Description: Automatically determine the best programming language for the agent
Technical Details: A dedicated LLM prompt analyzes the user's requirements to select the most appropriate language. Defaults to Python if no clear language is specified.

Description: Generate complete, production-ready Python agent code
Technical Details: Generates 4 files via focused, individual Groq calls: agent.py (main logic), main.py (entry point), requirements.txt (dependencies), README.md (documentation). Includes retry logic (3 attempts) and output cleaning.

Description: AI-based review of generated code against specification
Technical Details: Sends both the specification JSON and generated code to Groq for structured review. Returns correctness_percentage, implemented_correctly/partially/not_implemented lists, issues, and summary.

Description: Produce a comprehensive markdown report of the generated agent
Technical Details: Reads all 4 generated files, sends each to Groq for AI analysis, generates step-by-step run instructions, and assembles a full markdown report.

Description: Interactive web UI for pipeline execution and artifact viewing
Technical Details: Flask-served dark-mode UI with chat interface, real-time pipeline status tracking, tabbed artifact viewer (Report/agent.py/main.py/requirements.txt/README.md/Spec JSON), and prompt history sidebar.

Description: Persist all user prompts with timestamps in CSV format
Technical Details: Every prompt is appended to input.csv with ISO timestamp. Frontend sidebar displays history in reverse chronological order with click-to-reuse.

Description: Validate and sanitize all user inputs
Technical Details: Min 3 chars, max 5000 chars. Basic prompt injection sanitization (strips 'system prompt', 'ignore previous', 'you are now' patterns).
--skip-on-failure flag continues pipeline even if a step fails. Verifier step is non-fatal in web mode. Retry logic on Groq API calls (3 attempts).

Description: Generated code must follow best practices
Technical Details: System prompts enforce PEP 8, type hints, docstrings, logging over print, SOLID principles, proper error handling, and no hardcoded secrets.

Description: No secrets in generated code; safe API key handling
Technical Details: All API keys loaded from environment via python-dotenv. Generated code has regex-based secret stripping. .env excluded from git via .gitignore.
Each Groq API call configured with specific max_tokens limits (512-4096). Web server uses threading for async pipeline execution. 180-300s timeouts per step.

Description: User prompt is saved to input.csv with timestamp
Technical Details: Appends a new row [timestamp, user_input] to input.csv. Creates file with header row if it doesn't exist.

Description: Classify user input and route to appropriate path
Technical Details: Calls Groq to classify as 'agent_building' → continue pipeline, or 'conversational' → show answer and loop back. Robust JSON extraction with 5-level fallback.

Description: Extract structured agent specifications from plain text
Technical Details: Makes 4 separate Groq calls to extract: core specs (name, purpose, capabilities, domain), technical requirements (language, framework, DB), behavioral traits (tone, personality), and integration needs (APIs, systems). Merges results and applies defaults.

Description: Generate complete Python project from specification
Technical Details: Makes 4 focused Groq calls (one per file). Applies code cleaning: strips markdown fences, removes preamble prose, deduplicates imports, removes accidental secrets. Validates output structure.

Description: AI-based correctness review of generated code
Technical Details: Sends agent.py + main.py + spec JSON to Groq. Returns structured review with correctness_percentage, lists of correctly/partially/not implemented items, issues, and a summary. PASS/FAIL threshold at 60%.
Reads all 4 files from generated_agent/, sends each to Groq for analysis, generates step-by-step run instructions, and assembles a full markdown report with AI analysis + raw source code.
When classification = 'agent_building', the pipeline runs Steps 2-5 sequentially, generating the complete agent project.
When classification = 'conversational', a Groq call generates an informative answer + Agent Opportunity suggestion. Steps 2-5 are skipped. User is prompted to submit a building request.
Output: conversational_output.json, then loops back to input

Technical Details: Uses CLASSIFICATION_PROMPT to determine if user wants to build an agent or asks a question. Robust JSON extraction: direct parse → regex → keyword fallback → default. For conversational queries, generates answer with CONVERSATIONAL_PROMPT.

AdvancedAgentExtractor class with 4 extraction categories via separate LLM calls. build_simple_agent_json() merges results with DEFAULTS dict for 20+ fields. Includes interactive confirm_and_edit loop (CLI mode only).

Description: Code generator using focused LLM calls
Technical Details: CodeGeneratorAgent class generates 4 files with dedicated system prompts. clean_output() strips markdown fences, prose, duplicate imports, and secrets. validate_output() checks for class definitions, __init__, and unassigned self attributes. Uses capability-to-library hints mapping (_CAP_HINTS).
Sends spec JSON + agent.py + main.py to Groq with SYSTEM_VERIFIER prompt. Expects structured JSON response with correctness_percentage (0-100). PASS threshold = 60%.

Reads 4 expected files from generated_agent/, sends each to Groq for analysis, generates run instructions separately, and assembles markdown report with file analyses, raw source, and run instructions.

Provides: require_groq_api_key(), groq_client(), groq_chat() for plain text responses, groq_chat_json() for JSON-parsed responses. _extract_first_json_object() robustly extracts JSON from LLM output, handling code fences and trailing commas. Default model: llama-3.3-70b-versatile.

Runs all 5 steps sequentially with colored console output. Features: argparse CLI (--input, --input-file, --skip-on-failure, --start-from), pre-flight script validation, conversational loop (re-prompts user after conversational responses), final summary with pass/fail status and timing.

Description: Flask web server for frontend + REST API
Technical Details: Serves static frontend from ./frontend. Exposes REST API: POST /api/generate (start pipeline), GET /api/status/<id> (poll job), GET /api/result/<id> (fetch artifacts), GET /api/history (list past prompts). Runs pipeline in background thread. Manages per-job state in memory (jobs dict).

3 files: index.html (121 lines), app.js (340 lines), style.css (237 lines). Split-panel layout: left chat + right pipeline/artifacts. Real-time pipeline status polling (1.2s interval). Tabbed artifact viewer for all generated files. History sidebar with click-to-reuse. Toast notifications.
Accepts JSON body: {prompt: string}. Validates prompt (3-5000 chars). Creates job with UUID, spawns background thread. Returns {job_id, status: 'running'}.
Returns current job state: id, status (running/done/error), route, current_step (0-5), steps array with individual statuses, and error message if any.
Returns complete results: classification, agent_spec, verifier_result, conversational_response, generated files content, output_md report, and next_step_hint for conversational routes.
Output: Full result object with files, spec, report

Technical Details: Reads input.csv, returns last 50 entries in reverse chronological order as [{timestamp, prompt}].
Columns: timestamp (ISO 8601), user_input (text). Append-only. Created automatically on first prompt.
Contains: route, classification, user_text, confidence, reason, original_input. Produced only when classification = agent_building.
Contains: route, classification, user_text, conversational_response, confidence, reason, original_input. Produced only when classification = conversational.

20+ fields including: user input, agent_name, primary_purpose, capabilities[], domain, language, framework, api_integrations[], database, tone, personality[], external_apis[], etc. Defaults applied for missing values.
Contains 4 files: agent.py (main agent class with all capabilities), main.py (entry point), requirements.txt (pinned dependencies), README.md (full documentation).

Contains: ai_review (correctness_percentage, implemented_correctly[], implemented_partially[], not_implemented[], issues[], summary), overall_correctness_percentage, threshold (60), overall_status (PASS/FAIL).
Markdown report with: generation metadata, files detected, run instructions, per-file AI analysis + raw source code. Generated by code_interface_agent.py.
Python 3.x used for all backend agents, pipeline orchestration, and web server.

Technical Details: Flask 3.0+ with Flask-CORS for cross-origin support. Serves frontend static files and exposes REST API endpoints. Runs on port 5000.
